# MapInfoPanel

Information about a map: host-provided introduction, optional branding, FAQs, copyright/provider credits, support/legal links and explicitly labelled versions. Available as React MapInfoPanel, SwiftUI KozmosMapInfoPanel and Compose KozmosMapInfoPanel. MapInfo / KozmosMapInfo supplies the trigger and responsive presentation around a map shell.

- **Import:** `import { MapInfo, MapInfoPanel } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Product
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/product-sdk-mapinfopanel--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { MapInfoPanel, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function MapInfoPanelExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <MapInfoPanel
        onClose={() => {}}
        style={{ width: 384, minHeight: 720 }}
        content={{
          title: "About this map",
          introduction:
            "Explore the venue and find the places and services you need.",
          faqs: [
            {
              id: "floors",
              question: "How do I change floors?",
              answer: "Open the floor selector and choose a level.",
            },
          ],
          credits: [{ id: "owner", label: "Indoor map data © Example venue" }],
          links: [
            {
              id: "support",
              label: "Contact support",
              href: "mailto:support@example.com",
            },
          ],
          versions: [{ id: "app", label: "App version", value: "Example" }],
        }}
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## MapInfoPanel

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `MapInfoPanelProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "content" | "title">`.

- `content`: `MapInfoContent`, **required**.
- `brand`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Optional approved artwork. Caller supplies an accessible label for meaningful logos.

- `onClose`: `() => void`, **required**.
- `closeLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Close information"`.
- `faqLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Frequently asked questions"`.
- `copyrightLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Copyright"`.
- `expandedFAQ`: `string`, optional.

  Optional controlled FAQ ID, retained by MapInfo across presentation changes.

- `onExpandedFAQChange`: `(id: string) => void`, optional.
- `closeButtonRef`: `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>`, optional.
- `titleId`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## MapInfo

Non-modal logical-end panel on wide hosts; full-viewport modal on compact hosts.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `MapInfoProps`, which extends `Omit<MapInfoPanelProps, "onClose" | "closeButtonRef" | "titleId" | "expandedFAQ" | "onExpandedFAQChange">`.

- `open`: `boolean`, **required**.
- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, **required**.
- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, **required**.

  The existing map shell. Kept mounted when Info opens, closes or changes presentation.

- `triggerLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Information"`.
- `available`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.

  Hide the capability without hiding map content.

- `content`: `MapInfoContent`, **required**.
- `brand`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  Optional approved artwork. Caller supplies an accessible label for meaningful logos.

- `closeLabel`: `string`, optional.
- `faqLabel`: `string`, optional.
- `copyrightLabel`: `string`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### MapInfoContent

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
/** Localized, host-owned content. No HTML, provider inference, legal copy or version defaults. */
interface MapInfoContent {
  title: string;
  introduction?: string;
  faqs?: readonly MapInfoFAQ[];
  credits?: readonly MapInfoEntry[];
  links?: readonly MapInfoEntry[];
  versions?: readonly MapInfoVersion[];
}
```

### MapInfoFAQ

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface MapInfoFAQ {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
}
```

### MapInfoEntry

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface MapInfoEntry {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}
```

### MapInfoVersion

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
interface MapInfoVersion {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}
```
